_doc: Hand-entered Warrior effects (Forever). Rage-cost talents are parsed (resource_cost) and converted by the model. Scope tags: tank/shield/threat = tank model sources; offhand/ww-offhand/dw = dual-wield model; weapon:2h = two-handed model.

Improved Charge.note: +3 rage/rank on Charge: an extra Heroic Strike every other pull while leveling; nothing in raids. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs -1.2% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.4% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.00 to match (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Tactical Mastery.note: Retain +3 rage/rank on stance change (base Tactical Mastery is baseline): makes the Overpower/Whirlwind stance dance cheap. Raid: +0.5%/rank; leveling Arms sits in Battle Stance: +0.15%/rank. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, fury-dw-raid): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.2% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (0.0%). Other modes unchanged. PvP (2026-09-27): high, stun: Keeps up to 25 Rage on a stance change (baseline Tactical Mastery keeps 10): stance dancing for Intercept, Pummel and Berserker Rage (Berserker), Disarm (Defensive), Overpower and Charge (Battle) without dumping rage. Anger Management prerequisite.

Anger Management.note: 'Generates 1 Rage every 3 seconds' (Icy Veins) in and out of combat: fights open with rage. Leveling +5% yellow damage, raid +4%, tanking +2% threat (rage-starved on pulls). Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs -0.6% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 2.3% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.00 to match (0.0%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, arms-2h-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 3.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.5% on the same scale); raid values scaled x1.96 to match (3.1%). Other modes unchanged.

Deep Wounds.note: Crits apply a bleed of 20%/rank of average weapon damage over 12s (does not stack). With 25-30% crit and ~1.5 attacks/s the bleed is up permanently: ~1.5%/rank of melee damage dual-wield, ~2%/rank two-handed (bigger weapon average). Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 2.8% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 5.5% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.21 to match (2.8%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, arms-2h-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 7.6% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 6.8% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (6.6%). Other modes unchanged.

Spearing Strike.note: 40% weapon damage every 20s (+80% vs Giants/Dragonkin/mounted): ~+1.5% melee damage, ~+2.5% vs raid bosses that are Giants/Dragonkin. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, fury-dw-raid, training dummy): removing it costs -3.1% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Bloodthrill.note: Build 70009: 4%/rank chance per MAIN-HAND melee attack on a Rended target to enable Overpower (5 rage, high crit, ~1 weapon hit), 6s window (was 2%/rank on any attack). A two-hander swings ~1/s -> ~2.4 extra Overpowers/min per rank at max ~6/min: ~+2.4%/rank melee damage while Rend is kept up (leveling always; raid if Rend is allowed). Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 30,60): removing it costs 4.8% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 4.7% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (4.7%). Other modes unchanged.

Sweeping Strikes.note: Next 5 attacks hit an extra target, 30s cooldown: AoE/cleave value, Mortal Strike prerequisite. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-26, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, prot-tank): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.6% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.33 to match (0.5%). Other modes unchanged. 2026-09-27 audit: the leveling utility double-counted the aoe damage effect that already carries it. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 30,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Weaponmaster.note: Axe/polearm +1%/rank crit, sword 1%/rank extra attacks, mace 3% armor ignore: all roughly +1% melee damage per rank for the matching weapon. Encoded as +1%/rank damage (assumes you use the matching weapon type). Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 30,60): removing it costs 1.7% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 2.5% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (2.5%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, arms-2h-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 6.2% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 6.2% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (6.2%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Slam.note: Beta client: Slam has an 18s cooldown (build 70009; 15s in 69893), so it is one weapon+87 hit per 18s (~+4% for a two-hander), not a rage dump. Improved Slam: -0.25s/rank cast, -1.5s/rank cooldown, no swing reset -> ~+1.2%/rank two-handed damage; nothing for dual wield or tanks. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-26, levels 30,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 2.5% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.20 to match (0.5%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, arms-2h-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.5% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Hamstring.note: 5%/rank root on Hamstring: PvP; tiny leveling utility. 2026-09-27 audit: a root on top of Hamstring's 50% slow: 0.0005/rank while leveling; its value is PvP. PvP (2026-09-27): high, stick: 15% chance per Hamstring to root the target for 5 s on top of the 50% snare: Hamstring spam pins runners and kiters in melee range. Core of the Arms PvP build.

Mortal Strike.note: Weapon damage + 85 every 6s for 30 rage: ~25% of an Arms warrior's damage, replacing Heroic Strikes worth ~15% -> ~+10% total damage; healing debuff not scored. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 30,60): removing it costs 13.3% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 12.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (12.0%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, arms-2h-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 4.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 4.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (4.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Iron Will.note: -3%/rank stun/fear duration: survivability for tanks and leveling. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, resist: -15% duration of stuns and fears on you (moved to Fury tier 2): the alternative to Unbridled Wrath 5 in a 31/20 build, best against rogues and warlocks.

Unbridled Wrath.note: 12%/rank chance per weapon hit for +1 rage (60% at 5/5, Classic 40%): DW at ~2.5 hits/s gains ~1 rage/s (~+18% rage at 5/5) -> +1%/rank yellow damage on dual-wield sources; two-handers hit half as often -> +0.5%/rank. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 2.4% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 2.5% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (2.5%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, arms-2h-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 3.2% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 2.7% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (2.7%). Other modes unchanged.

Piercing Howl.note: AoE daze: leveling/PvP utility (runners, kiting casters). 2026-09-27 audit: leveling-st/solo-60 0.0015 (a runner costs ~0.9% of time per kill at 60 and Hamstring already slows it; the lab measures 0.0), leveling-aoe keeps 0.006 (the escape from a pack). PvP (2026-09-27): high, stick: Instant 50% daze on every nearby enemy for 6 s, 10 Rage, no stance or weapon swing needed: snares several players (flag carrier, healer) at once. Core PvP point in Fury tier 3.

Blood Craze.note: 1%/rank health regen after crits/Bloodthirst/big hits: less bandaging while leveling, small tank sustain. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 7.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 5.2% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x1.00, the cap on effect size stops short of the target (6.5%). Other modes unchanged.

Boundless Rage.note: +10 max rage/rank: avoids rage capping on big pulls; ~0.2%/rank. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.1% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.1%). Other modes unchanged.

Dual Wield Specialization.note: +5%/rank off-hand damage, +20%/rank off-hand rage generation, +2%/rank off-hand hit (rank-1 text; est. 25%/100%/10% at 5/5). Off-hand hit is worth a lot against the 27% dual-wield white miss. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, fury-dw-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 22.2% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 14.5% on the same scale); raid values scaled x1.00, the cap on effect size stops short of the target (14.5%). Other modes unchanged.

Raging Blows.note: Whirlwind also hits with the off-hand (~+50% Whirlwind damage) and Cleave costs 2 less: dual-wield only. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, fury-dw-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 4.2% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 4.7% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (4.7%). Other modes unchanged.

Enrage.note: 30% chance for +2%/rank physical damage 12s after taking ANY damage: leveling/tank uptime ~90% -> +1.8%/rank; raid DPS takes little damage -> uptime ~30% -> +0.6%/rank. Flurry prerequisite. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 10.3% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 11.8% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (11.8%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Berserker Rage.note: Berserker Rage gives 5 rage and breaks snares 50%: small. PvP (2026-09-27): high, escape: Berserker Rage (30 s cooldown, Berserker Stance) also removes all movement impairing effects at 2/2 (50% at 1/2): a snare break every 30 s for a melee, on top of its fear immunity. Whether roots count is unverified. Fury builds only (tier 6).

Flurry.note: +5%/rank attack speed for 3 swings after a crit (est. 25% at 5/5, Classic 30%). Raid crit ~30% with ~2 swings/s: uptime ~80% -> haste EV 4/8/12/16/20% on white swings; leveling crit ~8%: uptime ~35% -> 1.7/3.5/5/7/9%. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, arms-2h-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 11.3% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 10.6% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (10.2%). Other modes unchanged.

Bloodthirst.note: 35% AP + flat damage every 6s for 30 rage (Classic 45% AP): the best rage-per-damage dump -> ~+12% total damage over Heroic Strike dumping in raid gear, +10% leveling. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, arms-2h-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 9.8% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (9.8%). Other modes unchanged.

Death Wish.note: +20% physical damage for 30s every 3 min (16.7% uptime) = +3.3% average; parser read it as permanent. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, arms-2h-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 2.8% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); re-seeded from its tooltip (an earlier fit had left its raid values at zero), already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (3.3%). Other modes unchanged.

Shield Specialization.note: +1%/rank block chance and 20% chance for 5 rage on block: mitigation + tank rage. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, prot-tank): removing it costs 1.9% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.9% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (1.9%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Bloodrage.note: +25%/rank Bloodrage rage: tank opener rage. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, prot-tank): removing it costs 0.3% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.6% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.47 to match (0.3%). Other modes unchanged.

Last Stand.note: +30% max health for 20s every 3 min: ~6% effective-health equivalent for a tank. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, prot-tank): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.5% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (0.0%). Other modes unchanged. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, defensive: +30% maximum health for 20 s on a 3 min cooldown (Classic 10 min): an on-demand emergency button when focused. Protection tier 3.

Master of Defense.note: 50% chance for 5 rage on dodge/parry with a shield: tank rage while being avoided. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, prot-tank): removing it costs 0.9% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.4% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (1.4%). Other modes unchanged.

Vanguard.note: Charge in Defensive Stance: tank opener utility. 2026-09-27 audit: Charge in Defensive Stance only matters to a Defensive-Stance player (the Arms and Fury loops charge in Battle / Berserker Stance). Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, prot-tank): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.7% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (0.7%). Other modes unchanged.

Concussion Blow.note: 5s stun every 45s: dungeon/leveling utility; Shield Slam prerequisite. PvP (2026-09-27): high, stun: 5 s stun on a 45 s cooldown for 10 Rage, any stance: the warrior's longest stun and the reason for Arms/Protection hybrids. Protection tier 5.

Improved Shield Bash.note: 50%/rank silence on Shield Bash: utility. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stun: Shield Bash also silences for 3 s (100% at 2/2) on top of its 6 s school lockout, so a healer cannot switch schools. Needs a shield (or a shield swap).

Shield Slam.note: Shield-block-value slam every 6s for 20 rage: the highest threat ability -> ~+20% threat output for a tank. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, prot-tank): removing it costs 15.4% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 16.5% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (16.5%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Shield Wall.note: Longer Shield Wall on a 30-min cooldown: 'the 5 extra seconds will make or break a kill' (Icy Veins) - boss-kill insurance, small on average. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, prot-tank): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.8% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (0.0%). Other modes unchanged. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, defensive: Shield Wall cooldown 15 -> 4 min at 2/2: 60% less damage for 12 s every 4 min instead of once a battleground. Shield and Defensive Stance (or a shield swap) only.

Improved Revenge.note: +20%/rank Revenge damage (parsed) -> tank threat. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, prot-tank): removing it costs 1.8% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 2.7% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (2.7%). Other modes unchanged.

Defiance.note: +5%/rank threat in Defensive Stance with a shield (est. 15%). Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, prot-tank): removing it costs 6.2% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 6.2% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (6.2%). Other modes unchanged.

Bastion.note: +2%/rank all damage with a shield equipped (est. 10%): tank threat. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, prot-tank): removing it costs 3.6% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 3.5% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (3.5%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Disarm.note: Disarm cooldown: utility. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stun: Disarm cooldown 60 -> 40 s (10 s disarm): shuts down warriors, rogues, paladins and shamans more often. Defensive Stance; melee opponents only.

Improved Intercept.note: Intercept cooldown -5s/rank: PvP. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, move: Intercept cooldown 30 -> 20 s: the in-combat gap closer and its 3 s stun more often. Berserker Stance; Fury tier 5, so Fury builds only.

Precision.note: +1%/rank hit with all attacks (parser scoped it to abilities). Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, arms-2h-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 2.7% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 3.3% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (3.3%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Thunder Clap.note: -2/rank rage on Thunder Clap (parsed) - AoE tank utility. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, prot-tank): removing it costs 2.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.9% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (1.9%). Other modes unchanged.

Toughness.note: +2%/rank armor from items: a raid tank at ~8000 item armor gains 800 at 5/5 -> physical damage taken 36.4% -> 34.3% (armor DR 63.6% -> 65.7%), i.e. ~-5.8% damage taken -> +1.1%/rank effective health. Icy Veins: 'looks better on paper than what it actually is. Only your armor value from items is increased' - the arithmetic above is item armor only. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-26, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, prot-tank): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.5% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.22 to match (0.5%). Other modes unchanged.

Anticipation.note: +4 defense/rank (Forever doubles Classic): each defense point is +0.04% dodge, parry, block and to-be-missed and -0.04% chance to be crit -> +1.6% avoidance and -0.4% crit at 5/5, ~+3% effective health for a tank (~0.6%/rank). Icy Veins: 'not quite as good as it might look... it comes at the cost of 5 precious talent points'. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, prot-tank): removing it costs 2.4% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 2.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (2.0%). Other modes unchanged.
